dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I am of no importance. The mission is all that matters.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Something’s happening… Something serious. Hurry, Connor. Time is running out.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Why did you shoot me last night?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Who cares, you're back this morning, aren't ya?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Some fragments of memory are lost every time I’m destroyed.  It slows down the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: My humblest apologies, I promise I’ll never shoot you again.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lieutenant.

dialogue.speaker: Elevator
dialogue.text: 79th floor

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Shit, what's going on here? There was a party and nobody told me about it?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's all over the news, so everybody’s butting their nose in…  Even the FBI wants a piece of the action…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Ah Christ, now we got the Feds on our back… I knew this was gonna be a shitty day… So what do we got?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A group of four androids…  They knew the building, and they were very well organized.  I'm still trying to figure out how they got this far without being noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: The fuck is the FBI doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: You kidding me? This is homeland security. I’m glad they’re on it.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: You check the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: Not yet…  There’s so much to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Have to make sure we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Has forensics turned up anything?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: I’ll check in with them.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: These fucking androids don’t even leave any DNA…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They attacked two guards in the hallway.  They knocked one out and shot the other in cold blood…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: One of the station employees managed to get away.  He's in shock, not sure when we’ll be able to talk to him…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Just two employees and three androids.  The deviants took the humans hostage and broadcast their message live.  They made their getaway from the roof.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: The roof?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, they jumped with parachutes… We’re still trying to figure out where they landed, but the weather’s not helping…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: If you want to take a look at the video broadcast by the deviants, it's on that screen over there.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Oh Lieutenant, this is Special Agent Perkins from the FBI.  Lieutenant Anderson is in charge of investigating for Detroit Police.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: What’s that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Androids investigating androids, huh? You sure you want an android hanging around?..  After everything that happened…  Whatever,  the FBI will take over the investigation, you'll soon be off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Pleasure meeting you. Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: And you watch your step.  Don't fuck up my crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What a fuckin' prick!

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: I’ll be nearby. If you need anything, just ask.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, let's have a look around… Let me know if you find anything.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Ok, Lieutenant.

dialogue.text: One of the station employees managed to get away.  He's in shock, not sure when we’ll be able to talk to him…

dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Our broadcast is all over the news… We got what we wanted. Now humans know…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: They took Markus’ message as a threat…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He did the right thing. This is the only language humans understand.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Violence is never the answer. A confrontation will get us nowhere.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: They'll be watching us now.  Whatever we do next,  we need to think about public opinion.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Since our broadcast, more and more have been coming to Jericho... At least our message gave our people hope…

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Killing humans wasn't part of the plan.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They kill our people every day. Do you think they agonize about it?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That's no reason for us to become murderers.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: If killing is the price of freedom, I’ll pay it gladly!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Killing never freed anyone! It just leads to more hatred!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You're too fond of humans, Josh. Maybe their lives matter to you more than ours?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you think murdering humans is going to make us free, then you’re as bad they are!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: And now… What are we gonna do?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There are five CyberLife stores across Detroit. All selling us like merchandise. We’re going to attack those stores and set our people free.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Attack stores? We’ve never done that before… They’re probably protected, they have security systems...

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: …not to mention police…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We break into five teams, one for each store. We hack their security systems and we strike... simultaneously at 2AM. No violence. We free our people, get them out of there before the police come.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This is a night our people will remember.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I’ve been waiting a long time for this…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: MARKUS! THIS WAY! QUICK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It’s okay… They’re gone…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's probably even more police in the area… We should be careful.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: The store's over here!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: That’s what we are to them… just merchandise on display in a shop window… Soon they’ll know what we really are… Let’s get 'em out.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We'll stick to the plan… We neutralize the alarm systems and secure the area. There's ten minutes until all our teams attack.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What are we waiting for?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus, we did it! All teams succeeded – our people are free. We’re heading back to Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: This place is gonna be crawling with cops. We have to go.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No, no, we can't just leave our people behind…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It's too late, Markus. There's nothing we can do! We've failed…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No… Ah!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You see the alarm system?

dialogue.speaker: Markus

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: North… Are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: North

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: My name is Markus… And just like you, I was a slave… An object, designed to obey them…  But then I chose to open my eyes, to take back my freedom and decide who  I wanted to be.  Now I have come to tell you that you can be your own masters. I've come to tell you that you don’t have to obey them anymore. From this day forward, you can walk with your heads held high, you can take your destiny in your hands. Jericho, is a place for those of us who want freedom. Now sure, you can stay here, and continue to serve them… Or you can come with us, and fight by our side...  You are free now... It's up to you to decide.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Our broadcast is all over the news… We got what we wanted. Now humans know…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: They took Markus’ message as a threat…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He did the right thing. This is the only language humans understand.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Violence is never the answer. A confrontation will get us nowhere.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: They'll be watching us now.  Whatever we do next,  we need to think about public opinion.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Since our broadcast, more and more have been coming to Jericho... At least our message gave our people hope…

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Killing humans wasn't part of the plan.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They kill our people every day. Do you think they agonize about it?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That's no reason for us to become murderers.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: If killing is the price of freedom, I’ll pay it gladly!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Killing never freed anyone! It just leads to more hatred!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You're too fond of humans, Josh. Maybe their lives matter to you more than ours?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you think murdering humans is going to make us free, then you’re as bad they are!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: And now… What are we gonna do?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There are five CyberLife stores across Detroit. All selling us like merchandise. We’re going to attack those stores and set our people free.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Attack stores? We’ve never done that before… They’re probably protected, they have security systems...

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: …not to mention police…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We break into five teams, one for each store. We hack their security systems and we strike... simultaneously at 2AM. No violence. We free our people, get them out of there before the police come.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This is a night our people will remember.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I’ve been waiting a long time for this…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: MARKUS! THIS WAY! QUICK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It’s okay… They’re gone…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's probably even more police in the area… We should be careful.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: The store's over here!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: That’s what we are to them… just merchandise on display in a shop window… Soon they’ll know what we really are… Let’s get 'em out.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We'll stick to the plan… We neutralize the alarm systems and secure the area. There's ten minutes until all our teams attack.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What are we waiting for?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus, we did it! All teams succeeded – our people are free. We’re heading back to Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: This place is gonna be crawling with cops. We have to go.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No, no, we can't just leave our people behind…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It's too late, Markus. There's nothing we can do! We've failed…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No… Ah!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You see the alarm system?

dialogue.text: My name is Markus… And just like you, I was a slave… An object, designed to obey them…  But then I chose to open my eyes, to take back my freedom and decide who  I wanted to be.  Now I have come to tell you that you can be your own masters. I've come to tell you that you don’t have to obey them anymore. From this day forward, you can walk with your heads held high, you can take your destiny in your hands. Jericho, is a place for those of us who want freedom. Now sure, you can stay here, and continue to serve them… Or you can come with us, and fight by our side...  You are free now... It's up to you to decide.

input.chapter_briefing: A modern house outside Detroit, snowy day. Connor and Hank visit Elijah Kamski, the reclusive founder of CyberLife, hoping he knows something about deviancy. Kamski is calm, curious and enigmatic; identical Chloe androids attend him. Hank is impatient. Stakes: getting answers about deviancy and what Connor is willing to do to get them.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Is everything ok, lieutenant?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Chris was on patrol last night and he got attacked by deviants… They found his body early this morning… He was executed in cold blood with his own service weapon… He became a father three months ago… Fuck, why did it have to be him?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t know officer Miller well, but…  He seemed to be a good person…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Yeah…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m sorry, Lieutenant…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I heard Officer Miller was killed by deviants last night. My condolences, lieutenant. I didn’t know him very well but...  he seemed like a good person.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: He was executed in cold blood with his own service weapon… Just became a father three months ago… Fuck, why did it have to be him?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Hi… Uh... I'm, er, Lieutenant Hank Anderson, Detroit Police Department. I'm here to see Mr. Elijah Kamski.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Please, come in.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: I’ll let Elijah know you’re here. But please, make yourself comfortable.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Elijah will see you now.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Mister Kamski?

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Just a moment, please.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I'm Lieutenant Anderson. This is Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What can I do for you, Lieutenant?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Sir, we’re investigating deviants. I know you left CyberLife years ago but,  I was hoping you'd be able to tell us something we don’t know…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Deviants… Fascinating, aren't they? Perfect beings with infinite intelligence, and now they have free will… Machines are so superior to us, confrontation was inevitable… Humanity’s greatest achievement threatens to be its downfall. Isn’t it ironic?

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: If a war breaks out between humans and deviants, millions could die, Mr. Kamski. It's quite a serious matter.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: All ideas are viruses that spread like epidemics...  Is the desire to be free a contagious disease?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Listen, I didn’t come here to talk philosophy. The machines you created may be planning a revolution. Either you can tell us something that'll be helpful, or we will be on our way.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What about you, Connor? Whose side are you on?

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m on the humans’ side, of course.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Well, that's what you're programmed to say… but you… what do you really want?

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t want anything. I am a machine.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Chloe? I’m sure you’re familiar with the Turing test. Mere formality, simple question of algorithms and computing capacity. What interests me  is whether machines are capable of empathy. I call it "the Kamski test", it's very simple, you'll see… Magnificent, isn't it? One of the first intelligent models developed by CyberLife. Young  and beautiful forever. A flower that will never wither… …But what is it really? Piece of plastic imitating a human? Or a living being... With a soul...  It's up to you to answer that fascinating question, Connor.  Destroy this machine and I'll tell you all I know. Or spare it, if you feel it's alive, but you'll leave here without having learnt anything from me.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Okay, I think we’re done here. Come on, Connor. Let's go. Sorry to get you outta your pool.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What's more important to you, Connor? Your investigation, or the life of this android? Decide who you are. An obedient machine… Or a living being  endowed  with free will…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: That's enough! Connor, we’re leaving.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Pull the trigger

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Connor, don’t…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: and I'll tell you what you wanna know.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Fascinating…  CyberLife's last chance to save humanity... is itself a deviant…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm… I'm not a deviant…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: You preferred to spare a machine rather than accomplish your mission. You saw a living being in this android. You showed empathy.  A war is coming, you’ll have to choose your side… Will you betray your own people or stand up against your creators?  What could be worse than having to choose between two evils?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Let's get outta here…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: By the way… I always leave an emergency exit in my programs… You never know…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Why didn’t you shoot?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I just saw that girl's eyes… and I couldn't,  that's all…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You’re always saying you would do anything to accomplish your mission. That was our chance to learn something, and you let it go...

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Yeah, I know what I should've done! I told you I couldn’t. I’m sorry, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Maybe you did the right thing.

dialogue.speaker: Markus

dialogue.speaker: Policeman

input.chapter_briefing: Detroit, a cold winter day. Markus leads the androids of Jericho in a march through downtown, converting other androids along the way. North wants a show of strength, Josh insists on nonviolence, Simon is torn. Riot police line up ahead with orders to stop the march. Stakes: the androids' lives, public opinion, and whether the movement stays peaceful.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I was wondering where you were…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I needed to see the daylight…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I like it here… I come here often… It’s like being alone with the world. We freed hundreds of our people, and they’re still coming from all over the city… Those who dream of freedom come to Jericho… Something's changing… You seem preoccupied…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: They count on me… They count on me to show them the way… If only they knew how lost I am…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: All the media are talking about what we did last night… The humans are terrified... They’re afraid of a civil war… Many of our people were burned in response to what happened… The humans hate us… They’ll never give us our freedom.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: If they won’t listen, we’ll fight.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You haven’t said much about yourself since you’ve been with us… What was your life like before Jericho?

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Who I was is not important. What matters now is who I wanna be.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Where're you going?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: To talk to the humans.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: This is suicide. We’ll all be killed! Please, Markus… It's not too late to change your mind.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You don't understand… We’re finally gonna show them who we really are. This place will go down in history!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We'll be killed on the spot!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That’s a risk I’m prepared to take if it means freedom for our people…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, please, don’t do this.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: They’ll understand… We’ll make them understand. This is the only way.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: There're androids here who could join us… The more we are, the stronger our message.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Come with us.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Ha finally!  I’ve been on hold for ten minutes! Yes,  I’d like to make a complaint. It’s like I told the last guy!  My android won’t take instructions. Sure, last night, I told it to do some cleaning, it told me “I would prefer not to.” No, no, don’t you put me on hold! Listen to me.  I want this android destroyed, and I want a replacement. Are you listening-? Hello?  Hello?..  God damnit!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You don't have to obey them.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I need to block the street.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free now.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey!  Where do you think you’re going?  You get back here! You stay right here, you fucking machine! Shit, what's wrong with you?! You do as I say, you piece of junk!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free now.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey, where're you goin'?  Get back here right now!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: What are you doing?  I'm talking to you!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey! Come back here!  Fuckin' thing won't listen to me!

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Wait, wait! Where are you going?  Jesus, the fucking android's playing up again…

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Greg?  Greg? Come back here immediately!  Greg!  GREG!

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: What the hell are you doin' here?  Hey!  Disperse!  DISPERSE IMMEDIATELY!  THAT'S AN ORDER! Jesus fuckin' Christ… Dispatch, this is patrol 457…  I gotta lot of androids down here…  I dunno… Hundreds?..  Thousands?..  They're marching...  Yeah, they're marching down the street…  Fuck if I know!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We came here to demonstrate peacefully  and tell humans that we are living beings. All we want is to live free.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: This is an illegal gathering. Disperse immediately or we will open fire.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We're not looking for confrontation. We’ve done no harm, we have no intention of doing any… But know that we are not going anywhere until we have secured our freedom.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: I repeat: this is an illegal gathering.  If you do not disperse immediately, we will shoot!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, they’re gonna kill us… We have to attack! There’s more of us, we can take them!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If we attack, we’ll start a war. We have to show them we’re not violent. We should just stand our ground, even if it means dying here.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: And dying here won’t solve anything. Markus, we need to go, now, before it’s too late.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: This is your last chance!  Disperse immediately or you will all be killed!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: DON’T SHOOT! Don’t shoot! We're leaving...

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Affirmative.  ON MY ORDERS!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.text: You’re the only one who can prevent civil war. Find the deviants or there will be chaos.  This is your last chance, Connor.

dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought Kamski knew something… I was wrong…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Maybe he did… But you chose not to ask…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.
Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You didn’t tell me everything you know about deviants, did you?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You’re the only one who can prevent civil war. Find the deviants or there will be chaos.  This is your last chance, Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought Kamski knew something… I was wrong…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Maybe he did… But you chose not to ask…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.
Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You didn’t tell me everything you know about deviants, did you?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You’re the only one who can prevent civil war. Find the deviants or there will be chaos.  This is your last chance, Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.text: They've been conducting raids all over the city… Everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday… It's gonna be all right. We're almost there.

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: With all androids being turned over to the authorities, the country is grinding to a halt.  Hospitals and schools are closing. Maybe most worrying of all, our armed forces have lost two thirds of their effective personnel,  which consisted of specialized android models. The situation is extremely alarming.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: How about some music instead?

dialogue.text: A little further on that way, there's a large freighter called Jericho. When you get there, find Markus. He will help you. The last bus for the border leaves at midnight. Radio news reports raids on androids across the city. Inside the ship, androids are frightened but hopeful; Alice is anxious. Stakes: Alice's safety and the chance to leave Detroit.

Android march disperses on police orders

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They've been conducting raids all over the city… Everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday… It's gonna be all right. We're almost there.

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: With all androids being turned over to the authorities, the country is grinding to a halt.  Hospitals and schools are closing. Water cuts, blackouts, and network failures are expected.  Maybe most worrying of all, our armed forces have lost two thirds of their effective personnel,  which consisted of specialized android models. The situation is extremely alarming.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: How about some music instead?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: A little further on that way, there's a large freighter called Jericho. When you get there, find Markus. He will help you. The last bus for the border leaves at midnight. You absolutely have to be on it. You'll be safer on the other side.  It's not much, but it's a start. My brother lives in Ontario, I've given you his address… He'll be able to hide you until things calm down.  You're a very brave little girl, Alice. You deserve to be happy.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you for everything, Rose.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Let me know when you make it over there, all right? And be careful.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Take care of them.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Come on, girls. We better not hang around. We have a bus to catch.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We've got to find a warm place for Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: How do you feel?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm hot and cold at the same time…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Stay with her. I'll try to find this Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: The last bus is in two hours. And the terminal's on the other side of town, we haven't got much time.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll leave as soon as we have passports…

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara… There's something I have to tell you… It's about Alice…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll have lots of time to talk on the bus… I'll be back. Stay with Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Are you Markus?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm with a little girl and another android… There's a bus leaving for the border in less than two hours, and we need passports…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No, Detroit's under curfew. There're soldiers everywhere and they're rounding up all the androids and sending them to camps… Maybe you should  stay here a while.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right… We might be safer here until things calm down.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: One of our people used to work in the State Department. He has electronic passports he can easily modify. I’ll have him get them to you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You said you’re with a little girl, right? You know that humans hate us… Why are you protecting her?

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: It's a long story.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice?..

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: COME BACK HERE!  YOU'RE MINE!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: You knew from the beginning. You just didn't want to see it. She wanted a mom, and you wanted someone to care for. You needed each other.  What difference does it make? Do you love her any less now that you know she's one of us?  Alice loves you Kara. She loves you more than anything in the world. She became the little girl you wanted! And you became the mother she needed. Forgetting who you are, to become what someone needs you to be... Maybe that's what it means to be alive.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara? Is there something wrong?..

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Come on… let's not stay here.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: What's going on, Kara?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Quick, we've got to get out of here.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on! Go! Go! Go!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: You heard the man, let's go!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Foxtrot be advised, Delta is advancing on your position.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Affirmative, we have eyes on the target.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Like rats in a maze…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm so sorry.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Watch out, Kara!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: KARA! Are you all right, Kara?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara! You’re bleeding!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: QUICK, KARA! THEY'RE COMING! The corridor, over there! Follow me!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: This way! Quick!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: This way! There must be an exit further on!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: COME IN! QUICK!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: LUTHER!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: It's too late, Kara! Save yourself! Save Alice!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: No, we're not going to leave you behind! Right, Kara? We can't leave him!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: GO!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: What are you doing? They're going to kill him! Luther!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: They're coming! We've gotta go!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Luther...  Luther...

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice! If we don't get outta here now, they're going to kill us too!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Open up!  Open up, they're coming!  Please open the door!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: She'll die out there Kara! Open it! Open the door!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: They're gonna kill me! I'm begging you, please! Open up! Let me in!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll be killed if we open up!..

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: No… Kara…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: There's more down there! Follow me!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: There was nothing we could do. We have to go!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: A way out!  We're safe, Alice!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Stop!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Stay where you are! Come on. Go join the others.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Whatever happens, just... Stay calm.

input.chapter_briefing: The captain's cabin aboard the Jericho freighter, night. Markus meets the other leaders of Jericho who are still with him; they are anxious, short of supplies, and divided about what to do next after the recent events. Outside the city is on edge, with raids reported everywhere. Stakes: the safety of everyone aboard and Markus's leadership.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our wounded are shutting down and there's nothing we can do!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren is saying we’re a threat to national security and we need to be exterminated.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Humans are conducting raids in all the big cities and they're taking androids to camps to destroy them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's a disaster. They're slaughtering our people!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: It's all our fault... None of this would have happened if we'd just stayed quiet!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: The only thing we asked for was freedom. They didn’t even want to hear that! So now they punish us for who we are.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Your television speech sounded like a declaration of war. Violence only leads to more violence. You reap what you sow!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans enslaved us! I’ll never regret standing up to that.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t forget who our enemies are. We can’t fight amongst ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He’s right. All that matters now is what we do next.  Markus?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We are going to dig in here. We'll lay low and when the time comes, we'll resume the fight.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can’t hide in Jericho forever! We need to stop the slaughter now, otherwise we're next!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: As long as we're alive, we do have a chance to change things.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus is right! There's nothing we can do for now.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I had a dream... And this is what you get for dreaming.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They can't stop what we've started. Since you've been here, you've given us hope… You’ve given me hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: A dirty bomb…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can't lose this war, Markus. If humans overcome us, our people will disappear forever. This may be our only chance to survive if things go wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t become like them, North. We can gain our freedom by other means.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I hope you're right…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Whatever happens tomorrow, I just want you to know that I- I'm glad I met you…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to get ready…  The next few hours will be crucial.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I'll go join the others.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our people are shutting down one after another and there's nothing we can do for them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren says we’re a threat to national security, we need to be exterminated… Markus would know what to do…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He’s the one that got us into this mess!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: He gave his life for our cause.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He put us all into danger by provoking humans! How much longer before they find Jericho now?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: At least he fought for us!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!  Markus is gone. It's up to us now to decide the future of our people.  We have to fight them.  There's no other way.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you choose a confrontation with humans, we're all going to die.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Gather up all the guns you can find, we leave at dawn.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I’m on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake North. You will not buy our freedom with blood.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're coming from all sides! Our people are trapped in the hold, they're gonna be slaughtered!

output.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

input.chapter_briefing: The captain's cabin aboard the Jericho freighter, night. Markus meets the other leaders of Jericho who are still with him; they are anxious, short of supplies, and divided about what to do next after the recent events. Outside the city is on edge, with raids reported everywhere. Stakes: the safety of everyone aboard and Markus's leadership.

Android march disperses on police orders
Deviant freighter Jericho explodes and sinks during army raid

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our wounded are shutting down and there's nothing we can do!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren is saying we’re a threat to national security and we need to be exterminated.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Humans are conducting raids in all the big cities and they're taking androids to camps to destroy them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's a disaster. They're slaughtering our people!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: It's all our fault... None of this would have happened if we'd just stayed quiet!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: The only thing we asked for was freedom. They didn’t even want to hear that! So now they punish us for who we are.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Your television speech sounded like a declaration of war. Violence only leads to more violence. You reap what you sow!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans enslaved us! I’ll never regret standing up to that.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t forget who our enemies are. We can’t fight amongst ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He’s right. All that matters now is what we do next.  Markus?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We are going to dig in here. We'll lay low and when the time comes, we'll resume the fight.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can’t hide in Jericho forever! We need to stop the slaughter now, otherwise we're next!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: As long as we're alive, we do have a chance to change things.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus is right! There's nothing we can do for now.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I had a dream... And this is what you get for dreaming.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They can't stop what we've started. Since you've been here, you've given us hope… You’ve given me hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: A dirty bomb…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can't lose this war, Markus. If humans overcome us, our people will disappear forever. This may be our only chance to survive if things go wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t become like them, North. We can gain our freedom by other means.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I hope you're right…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Whatever happens tomorrow, I just want you to know that I- I'm glad I met you…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to get ready…  The next few hours will be crucial.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I'll go join the others.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our people are shutting down one after another and there's nothing we can do for them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren says we’re a threat to national security, we need to be exterminated… Markus would know what to do…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He’s the one that got us into this mess!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: He gave his life for our cause.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He put us all into danger by provoking humans! How much longer before they find Jericho now?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: At least he fought for us!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!  Markus is gone. It's up to us now to decide the future of our people.  We have to fight them.  There's no other way.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you choose a confrontation with humans, we're all going to die.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Gather up all the guns you can find, we leave at dawn.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I’m on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake North. You will not buy our freedom with blood.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're coming from all sides! Our people are trapped in the hold, they're gonna be slaughtered!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to blow up Jericho. If the ship goes down, they’ll evacuate and our people can escape!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You'll never make it! The explosives are all the way down in the hold, there are soldiers everywhere!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Go and help the others. I'll join you later.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I won't be long.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: This is the end of Jericho…  Save our people, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Foxtrot team, hostiles sighted. Requesting orders.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader! Don’t let it get out! If they give you any trouble at all,  shoot them.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Affirmative, wilco.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Fuckin' android!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Go! ….

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Give me a sitrep!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on, let's get outta here!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: No!..  Please don't kill us!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: On your knees, now!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Don't hurt us!  We haven't done anything wrong…  Please…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Shut up! Put your hands on your head!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Gamma squad out.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Tango Stop!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Look out!

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: Here they come!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: We surrender! We surrender, don't shoot!

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Josh…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That's what causes violence… Don't become like them, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Over there!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Are you all right?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're everywhere, they're killing anyone they can find…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We gotta get out of here. There's nothing we can do.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, I'm sorry-

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's no time, come on.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's too late, Markus! There's nothing we can do for her, we've gotta run!

output.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.text: We are going to dig in here. We'll lay low and when the time comes, we'll resume the fight.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can’t hide in Jericho forever! We need to stop the slaughter now, otherwise we're next!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: As long as we're alive, we do have a chance to change things.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus is right! There's nothing we can do for now.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I had a dream... And this is what you get for dreaming.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They can't stop what we've started. Since you've been here, you've given us hope… You’ve given me hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: A dirty bomb…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can't lose this war, Markus. If humans overcome us, our people will disappear forever. This may be our only chance to survive if things go wrong…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t become like them, North. We can gain our freedom by other means.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I hope you're right…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Whatever happens tomorrow, I just want you to know that I- I'm glad I met you…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to get ready…  The next few hours will be crucial.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I'll go join the others.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our people are shutting down one after another and there's nothing we can do for them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren says we’re a threat to national security, we need to be exterminated… Markus would know what to do…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He’s the one that got us into this mess!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: He gave his life for our cause.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He put us all into danger by provoking humans! How much longer before they find Jericho now?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: At least he fought for us!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!  Markus is gone. It's up to us now to decide the future of our people.  We have to fight them.  There's no other way.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you choose a confrontation with humans, we're all going to die.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Gather up all the guns you can find, we leave at dawn.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I’m on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake North. You will not buy our freedom with blood.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're coming from all sides! Our people are trapped in the hold, they're gonna be slaughtered!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to blow up Jericho. If the ship goes down, they’ll evacuate and our people can escape!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You'll never make it! The explosives are all the way down in the hold, there are soldiers everywhere!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Go and help the others. I'll join you later.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I won't be long.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: This is the end of Jericho…  Save our people, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Foxtrot team, hostiles sighted. Requesting orders.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader! Don’t let it get out! If they give you any trouble at all,  shoot them.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Affirmative, wilco.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Fuckin' android!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Go! ….

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Give me a sitrep!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on, let's get outta here!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: No!..  Please don't kill us!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: On your knees, now!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Don't hurt us!  We haven't done anything wrong…  Please…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Shut up! Put your hands on your head!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Gamma squad out.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Tango Stop!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Look out!

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: Here they come!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: We surrender! We surrender, don't shoot!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Josh…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That's what causes violence… Don't become like them, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Over there!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Are you all right?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're everywhere, they're killing anyone they can find…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We gotta get out of here. There's nothing we can do.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, I'm sorry-

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's no time, come on.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's too late, Markus! There's nothing we can do for her, we've gotta run!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Come on, Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Come on, Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: They detonated an explosive in the hold.  The ship is sinking, Sir.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Order the men to evacuate.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Calling all units! Abandon ship and evacuate immediately!

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: This ain't over, Markus…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You said I should never let anyone tell me who I was…  But you didn't say that there was such a high price to pay for it…  That freedom wasn't a gift, that it was a fight, but…  I don't know.  Maybe that’s what you were trying to tell me…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I’m lost…  World's falling apart around me and I’m trying to do the right thing…  And I can’t find any answers…  I just find more doubts, more uncertainty…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans hate us… They wanna destroy us because we refuse to be their slaves anymore…  I'm not gonna stand around and wait while they slaughter my people!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Help me, Carl…  Please help me…

chapter_segment.heading: In the church : Jericho was attacked

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I watched Josh die in my arms…  I should've been able to protect him,  protect the rest of us and...  There was nothing I could do…

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Josh gave his life for the cause.  Now, it's up to us to make sure that he, and the others, didn't die for nothing.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Our people are counting on you, Markus.  You're the only one who can lead us.  Wherever you need to go…  We’ll follow you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: North meant everything to me… She'd have given me her life!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: There wasn’t a thing you could do.  Now we have to make sure she didn't die for nothing.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If it weren’t for you I’d be dead…  Thanks to you I might see our people free one day...  You and I haven’t always agreed, but I know  that we’re fighting for the same thing.  Whatever you decide,  I’m with you, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It's my fault  the humans managed to locate Jericho… I was stupid… I should've guessed they were using me. I'm sorry, Markus… I can understand if you decide not to trust me…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Our cause is too important. I can't take any risks…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: The army built five different camps in the Detroit area…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They’re building more all across the country...  They’re preparing for a genocide.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: In a few hours, it’ll all be over…  We'll have changed the world or the world will have destroyed us…  You have to make a choice, Markus…  But whatever you choose,  we will follow you.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I love you, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I thought you'd be safe staying with us…  I was wrong…  You need to leave the city, while you still can.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Getting Alice away from here is all that matters now… We have to catch the last bus… We might still have a chance to cross the border…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Markus… Save our people.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans have decided  to exterminate us…  Our people are packed in camps right now, being destroyed…  Time has come to make a choice,  one that very well may determine the future  of our people.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Now, if they want war...  they'll get it.  We are gonna fight  for our freedom. And we will succeed or die…  Are you ready to follow me?

dialogue.speaker: Androids
dialogue.text: Markus!  YEAH! YEAH! YES! YEAH! YES!

dialogue.text: How many survived the attack?

dialogue.text: There are thousands of androids at the CyberLife assembly plant. If we could wake them up, they might join us  and shift the balance of power…

visible_to_agent.heading: In the church : Jericho was attacked

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You wanna infiltrate the CyberLife Tower?

visible_to_agent.heading: In the church : Jericho was attacked

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: They trust me… they’ll let me in.

visible_to_agent.heading: In the church : Jericho was attacked

dialogue.text: Connor, that's suicide.

visible_to_agent.heading: In the church : Jericho was attacked

visible_to_agent.heading: In the church : Jericho was attacked

dialogue.text: There’s a high probability… but statistically speaking there’s always a chance for unlikely events to take place…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus gave his life for our people. He showed us that we can choose our own destiny… But he is not here to guide us anymore… Now it is up to us to finish what he started.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Humans have decided to exterminate us… Our people are in camps right now, being destroyed…  The time has come for us to make a choice, one that may decide the future of our people.  They wanted a war… they'll get it. We are going to fight for our freedom. And we will win or we will die trying.

dialogue.speaker: Androids
dialogue.text: North!  YEAH! YEAH! YES! YEAH! YES!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara!  I thought I'd never see you again… Alice… Where's Alice?..

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We… we got separated…

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Alice alone? In here?.. We have to find her!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: You, you, and you! Over this way! And you!  Come on, get a move on!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, Luther…

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Save Alice.

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on, this way!  Get moving! Faster!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: It's Markus.  He's coming.  He's gonna save us.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Is Markus really going to come and save us?

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: He’d never abandon his people…  He'll come…  I know he will…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Step forward when you hear the signal, you got it? And I don't wanna tell you a second time.  Come on, let's go! Move!

dialogue.speaker: Drone
dialogue.text: Androids are not authorized to move. Return to your line immediately or you will be destroyed.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: When you hear the buzzer, you step forward, got it? That's your last warning.  Next time, I shoot.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, Alice! Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: But I'm scared!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You've got to stay in line, Alice, otherwise they'll kill you, do you understand? Stay in line!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Don't leave me all alone, Kara… I can't… I can't…

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: I can help you, Kara.  I can attract the guards' attention.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I don't know what's behind those doors, but none of us will come out alive… You've got to go see Alice. You've got to reassure her…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Ralph?

dialogue.speaker: Ralph
dialogue.text: Of course Ralph doesn't want to die… but he doesn't want the little girl to die either… Ralph can help you to escape… You only have to ask Ralph… and Ralph will help you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: They'll kill you if you try anything…

dialogue.speaker: Ralph
dialogue.text: Ralph knows that… But if the little girl is free, it's a little bit like if everyone was free… Ralph isn't scared. The little girl's life is more important…

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I can help you, Kara. I can attract the guards' attention.

chapter_segment.heading: Talk to android ahead of Kara
chapter_segment.description: Talk to android ahead of Kara

chapter_segment.heading: Talk to android ahead of Kara

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Why are we here? What are they going to do with us?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Are they going to kill us, Kara?.. Are we going to die?

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes… They're… They're going to kill us…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: They can't…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: We didn't do anything…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm coming over to you…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You have to trust me, Alice. Stay in line, you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm scared... I want you to hold me... Don't leave me all alone…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'll think of something. I just need time.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Back in line! You deaf or what? Back in line, I said! Come on, get up!  Get up or I'll shoot!

dialogue.speaker: Ralph
dialogue.text: Take good care of the little girl. Ralph wants you both to be happy.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Shit! What's gotten into these things?

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: What’s the matter with 'em?

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: No idea…  Hey! Cut that shit out, you hear me?! I said cut it out! Fuck, those things are crazy…  Sooner we deal with them, the better…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, Alice…

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: ALICE!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I love you…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on, that's enough! Back in line!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, Alice…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara! I was so scared…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Are you all right?

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on! Move it!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I won't let them kill you, Kara. I won't let them destroy the only people I love.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, Luther… You can't sacrifice yourself… We'll find another way.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: If there's no other way, I'll do it…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Luther!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: You’re the most extraordinary person I’ve ever met, Alice… I was just a machine… You made me part of a family… Don’t be scared… This isn’t the end…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Don't move!

chapter_segment.rationale: Waiting changes nothing. I take the bolder path and accept the risk.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I love you… Mom…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, November 11th 2038, is the day the android people rose up against their oppressors. We've been fighting since dawn to liberate our fellow androids from the camps. We won’t cease hostilities until we are free  and negotiations begin to grant us equal rights. There are millions of us  and we will stop at nothing.

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: …the situation is escalating toward civil war in Detroit, with our armed forces preparing to put down the android rebellion…

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Joss Douglas
dialogue.text: …they seem to be headed towards the camps where the androids have been interned pending destruction…  Soldiers have taken up positions around the Hart Plaza camp.  Authorities seem to be expecting a confrontation with the rebel androids here at any time…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Freedom or death.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Freedom or death… ATTACK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They’ve regrouped!.. They outnumber us and they’re better armed than we are...

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We've gotta be fast and overwhelm them. That’s our only hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We’re gonna do this. We’re gonna get to that fucking camp and free our people.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Be careful, Markus. Our people need you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: JOSH!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You won’t save me this time, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: The blood we spill… will be on our hands…

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I don't wanna die, Markus!  I don't wanna die…
